messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — Mariner Labs onboarding kickoff. Sharing a draft timeline and ownership ask. Need owners for infra, evals, enablement, and health tracking. Please flag risks. :wave:
Jordan Kim: I can own infra + dedicated sizing. Quick Q: are they planning Private/VPC or starting hosted?
Maya Patel: Starting hosted; evaluating Private (VPC) for PHI in Q3. For now we need hosted capacity plan and a VPC prep checklist.
Ethan Cho: I'll set up the initial model baseline + eval harness. ETA for first run: next Wed. Need sample prompts and a small dataset from Mariner to kick off.
Priya Rao: I'll coordinate enablement — proposing a 2-hr workshop. Options: May 6 or May 9. Which is better for engineering? :calendar:
Liam O'Connor: I'll take success criteria doc and the renewal-risk tracker. Suggest we use 30/60/90 milestones and a simple health score (adoption, latency, errors, security).
Maya Patel: Initial success criteria ideas: 1) Pilot stability (99% request success) 2) Latency median < 300ms for MLP endpoint 3) Adoption: 500 active users in pilot OR 10k tokens/day 4) Security signoffs completed. Thoughts?
Jordan Kim: For cost modeling I need expected concurrency and average sequence length. Carlos (AE) — can you confirm numbers?
Ethan Cho: Blocking from my side: SSO/SAML certs, and sample payloads (including streaming examples). We should mock streaming behavior in our test harness.
Priya Rao: Enablement scope: API walk-through, best practices for batching & cache, rollout checklist, and a Q&A session with engineering. I'll prepare slides.
Maya Patel: Risk flags: PHI/data access — requires legal review; timeline slippage if Mariner can't provide data; potential need for dedicated GPU if throughput > 200 req/s. Marking these as :warning: in the tracker.
Liam O'Connor: I'll set renewal_risk initial = "medium" because security requirements might push them to Private which increases cost/complexity.
Maya Patel: Quick timeline snippet (rough):
```
Week 0: Kickoff + SSO config
Week 1: Baseline eval + sample integration
Week 2: Workshop + perf tuning (batching/cache)
Week 4: Pilot go-live (limited users)
Week 8: Scale + SLA review
```
Jordan Kim: Can we get a short SOW draft by EOD Fri? I'll assemble infra estimates and cost bands.
Priya Rao: I'll send calendar invites once Alex (AE) confirms workshop date.
Ethan Cho: Created a test run template `tests/mariner_baseline.yaml` — will share link in the thread and add to repo.
OnboardBot: Reminder: create onboarding project in Gainsight and link the CSM playbook.
Maya Patel: Assignments: Jordan = infra/capacity, Ethan = evals + baseline runs, Priya = enablement + slides, Liam = health & renewal tracker. I'll own overall PM and status updates. Next sync: Thu 10am PT.
Jordan Kim: :white_check_mark: noted
Ethan Cho: :eyes: will start runs tomorrow morning
Priya Rao: :raised_hands: drafting slides now
Liam O'Connor: :thumbsup: I'll populate the tracker and add the risk column
Maya Patel: If you hit blockers (SSO certs, sample data), ping me directly. I'll follow up with legal on PHI questions. cc @Jordan Kim for infra questions. Thanks everyone.
